name: Rupture Devie
description: Manifestation d'une réalité parallèle, Rupture Devie émane de la Faille Dimensionnelle. Son existence même crée des distorsions spatio-temporelles, rendant les attaques ennemies imprévisibles et disjointes.

subject.archetype: Extra-dimensional Chaos Architect - Entity of pure dimensional dissonance, humanoid silhouette fractured between multiple overlapping realities, skin simultaneously intact and decomposed, one half of face pristine while other half is exposed skull with glitching neural tissue

loadout.armor_outfit: Armored military exoskeleton violently deformed by gravitational torsion - plates of dark metal warped like melted wax, sections phasing in and out of existence revealing void beneath, tattered crimson and violet robes underneath that float in defiance of physics, limbs positioned at anatomically impossible angles held together by crackling magenta energy threads, crown of floating geometric shards orbiting head
loadout.arsenal: Both palms joined generating concentrated nullification beam of pure dimensional collapse - beam comprised of intersecting violet and black energy spiraling in opposing rotations, surrounded by smaller orbiting fragments of shattered reality, secondary manifestation of glitching holographic tactical displays showing cascade failure propagating through enemy systems

attitude.behavior: Levitating at epicenter of reality collapse, body tilted forward in commanding stance, both arms extended forward with palms facing each other, fingers splayed directing impossible energies, whole form surrounded by halo of fragmented space-time, commanding gesture sweeping across visible spectrum of parallel battlefields
attitude.emotion: Absolute transcendent focus with hints of manic pleasure - eyes (if visible) burning with violet intellect beyond human comprehension, expression of cold cosmic certainty orchestrating destruction on multiversal scale, presence radiating oppressive dread and gravitational distortion

palette_names.name: Abyssal Black
palette_names.role: Primary shadow base, voids between realities

palette_names.name: Deep Violet
palette_names.role: Corrupted energy, psychic auras, main accent lighting

palette_names.name: Dried Blood Red
palette_names.role: Secondary accent, torn fabrics, damage indicators

palette_names.name: Neon Magenta
palette_names.role: Glitch effects, energy crackling, reality distortion highlights

palette_names.name: Scarred Pale Flesh
palette_names.role: Exposed flesh areas, biological horror elements

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Multi-source contradictory lighting - violet psychic glow emanating from subject contrasting with cold grey ambient from fractured sky, localized gravity lensing bending all light sources into impossible angles, self-illuminating energy from nullification beam creating volumetric magenta fog
color_and_light.mood: Oppressive cosmic dread mixed with chaotic destructive power, sense of reality unraveling, visually overwhelming dimensional collapse, strategic menace emanating from orchestrating presence

scenography.setting: Reality collapse epicenter - ground fractured into multiple geological layers simultaneously showing intact pristine battlefield and destroyed corrupted version underneath, buildings in background existing in two overlapping dimensional states (whole and rubble occupying same space), sky torn between conflicting celestial configurations (starfield conflicting with void and unnatural nebulae), floating debris masses in chaotic orbital patterns defying unified gravity, smaller chunks of reality drifting in impossible trajectories
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Reality glitching effect throughout entire scene - chromatic aberration at edges, scanline distortions, occasional frame-stutter visual artifacts, air visually fracturing like stressed glass, gravitational lensing distorting distant elements, particle effects of disintegrating matter caught between dimensions, cascading error visual patterns propagating across scene like corrupted digital imagery bleeding into physical reality, violet energy wisps threading through spatial fractures, distant screams of reality itself tearing
